from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    two = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    diagonal_steps = min(abs(tr - r) - 1, abs(tc - c) - 1)
    for _ in range(diagonal_steps):
        r += sr
        c += sc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3
    while (r, c) != (tr - sr, tc - sc):
        if r != tr - sr:
            r += sr
        elif c != tc - sc:
            c += sc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-decdaf0c.py'
path.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_decdaf0c',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
test=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]; test[1][4]=1; test[13][12]=2
result=mod.transform(test)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in result))
